assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios are low-confidence design evidence and must be recalculated after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, building density, green ratio, setbacks and parcel controls are absent.
assumptions.impact: The proposal states spatial principles and prototypes but no approved development-control values.

assumptions.statement: Cleared building footprints, uses, ages, ownership and retain-renovate-demolish surveys are absent.
assumptions.impact: Building objects are conceptual prototype footprints and update categories, not property decisions.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, station engineering, traffic counts and municipal networks are absent.
assumptions.impact: Connections are conceptual desire lines; bridge, tunnel, signal and construction feasibility are not claimed.

assumptions.statement: Cleared heritage protection boundaries for the railway park and historic assets are absent.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks are reversible public-interface prototypes and require heritage review before siting.

assumptions.statement: The civic AI probation, review and renewal cycle is a governance design proposal without confirmed operators, budget or approval.
assumptions.impact: Every programme is framed as a pilot protocol for professional and public deliberation.

assumptions.statement: Scenario metrics use public, consented or aggregated information and must not require personal tracking.
assumptions.impact: No-sensing routes, manual service and appeal channels remain available by design.
